Deepy Khadilkarr Mobile: 9146267319 Email: deepykhadilkar63@gmail.com Mumbai Thane.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/deepy-khadilkarr-142b17aa/

Business Analysis / Project Management / Data Governance Experience: 10 years 5 months

Operations / Trade Operations Experience: 10 years 3 months

Summary:

Business Analyst/IT Project Manager/ Project Manager with 12+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Knowledge of end- to-end trade life cycle management, Investment Banking and Consulting, IT Project Manager, leading complex, enterprise- scale projects across all phases of the SDLC.

Experienced in managing business requirements, functional specifications, process workflows, UAT, stakeholder communication, and delivery governance, while driving transformation initiatives across operations and technology teams. Expertise in Data Governance, Data Stewardship, Data Quality, reference data management, data profiling, issue remediation, and control frameworks, with hands-on experience partnering with Capital Markets Data Stewards and business stakeholders to improve data accuracy, reporting quality, and regulatory compliance. Demonstrated ability in bridging business and technology, driving structured delivery in Agile and Waterfall environments, and supporting strategic change across trade operations, reporting, and data-driven transformation programs.

Proven ability to lead and mentor small teams, including managing a 24 member team, allocating work, monitoring deliverables, providing functional guidance, resolving roadblocks, and ensuring timely completion of project milestones.

Skills



Project & Business Analysis: Requirement Gathering, Process Mapping, GAP Analysis, SDLC Methodologies, Documentation (BRD, FRD, FSD) , User Stories, Process Flows SOPs, UAT Guides, Training Materials, JIRA.



Project Management & Collaboration Tools: JIRA, Confluence, HP ALM, Stakeholder Management, Team Management, Agile methodology (Scrum, Waterfall), Risk and Issue Management, UAT Co-ordination. Executing projects from end-to-end.

Data & Reporting Tools: SQL, Power BI, Tableau, MS Excel, Data Governance & Data Quality, Data Stewardship, Data Profiling, Data cleansing, Governance.

Domain Skills : Regulatory Technology (Reg Tech), FRAUD Management (KYC, AML, Compliance Automation, Risk Management, Regulatory Reporting), Identity and Access Management(IAM), IAM Protocols (OAUTH, SAML, LDAP, SSO).Business Process Modelling Notation (BPMN)

Work Experience

Hoonar Tekwurks Jan 2021 - Nov 2025

Agile / Delivery / PM :









Led Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog governance across multiple PODs, ensuring timely sprint execution and delivery of project milestones. Supported Product Owners in refining user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing backlog items to align business requirements with sprint goals. Coordinated with cross-functional teams including Development, QA, Operations, and Security to manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and support delivery across multiple products and releases. Integrated CI/CD practices into Agile delivery processes, improving sprint execution and reducing release bottlenecks.

Managed internal and global stakeholder communication for releases, project updates, risks, and









dependencies, ensuring transparency and reducing escalations. Led end-to-end project/program delivery across the full SDLC using Agile and Waterfall methodologies, managing planning, governance, execution, testing, release, and closure activities. Served as the client-facing delivery lead, driving stakeholder engagement, governance, issue resolution, and delivery communication across business, Product Owners, and technology teams. Partnered with senior leadership, PMO, and Sales to define scope, support SOW preparation, budgeting, cost estimation, and financial governance. Established proper status reporting to all the Stakeholders to improve delivery tracking, reporting accuracy, to maintain transparency across stakeholders and Business Users.

2

Bahwan CyberTek

Senior Business Analyst Jun 2018 - Oct 2019

Worked as a Senior Business Analyst on the Oracle to SAP migration project, supporting end-to-end requirement gathering, process analysis, documentation, testing, and stakeholder coordination across business and technology teams. Engaged with business users and stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business requirements, functional requirements, process flows, and system change needs for migration from Oracle to SAP. Prepared and maintained key project documentation including BRD, FRD, process flows, user stories, and UAT artefacts to support project delivery in Confluence.





Managed and maintained requirements in HP ALM / Quality Center, ensuring proper requirement traceability,







test linkage, and defect tracking across the project lifecycle. Created and maintained RTM by linking business requirements to test cases, defects, and UAT scenarios in HP ALM. Liaised closely with development, QA, business, and support teams to clarify requirements, resolve functional queries, and support solution delivery. Participated in daily stand-up calls / Scrum meetings, tracking requirement progress, testing status, open issues, and dependencies.

Worked with the development team to explain business requirements, validate solution understanding, and



ensure alignment between business needs and system changes. Coordinated end-to-end testing and UAT, including test scenario preparation, execution tracking, defect management, retesting, and business sign-off.

MITS-BNP Paribas Services India Pvt Ltd Data Governance/Data Quality

Senior Business Analyst Mar 2016 - Jun 2018

•

Techno-Functional Role. (30% technical and 70% Functional). Partnered with Capital Markets Data Stewards and business stakeholders to understand critical data elements, reporting requirements, and data quality expectations across multiple business domains.

Worked closely with Data Stewards, Operations, and Technology teams to define, document, and validate data quality rules, business rules, and control checks for key Capital Markets data used in reporting and operational processes. Performed data profiling, data analysis, and root cause investigation using Informatica Data Quality (IDQ) to identify data anomalies, completeness issues, duplicate records, and standardization gaps. Collaborated with Data Stewards and SMEs to analyse recurring data quality issues, assess business impact, and define remediation actions and preventive controls. Translated business and reporting requirements into functional specifications, data quality rules, mappings, and validation logic for implementation by development and data quality teams. Coordinated with technology teams to implement approved data quality rules, cleansing logic, and remediation requirements, ensuring alignment with business and governance expectations.









HDFC Standard Life Insurance - Senior Associate Feb 2015 - Sep 2015



Investigated cases received in the Risk Team support mailbox daily, ensuring timely assessment and resolution.

Managed and closed Priority 1 DLP cases within 21 days, issuing Cause, Warning, and Termination letters based on thorough investigations.

BNP Paribas - Associate Jan 2011 - Dec 2014

Reference Data:

•

Provided a quality of service towards the business lines. Accountable for projects for the Asia region. (Singapore as well as Tokyo Region) and Account opening for Legal, Non-Legal, Sub-Accounts, Bonds and Fixed Income Products. Regular follow-ups and Investigation done with the counterparties to resolve the issues and doubts to streamline the process. Conducted third-eye review across all projects, including Equities and Fixed Income entities, as well as Operations functions. • Analysed data profiling results using Informatica to assess data quality, consistency, and completeness. • Maintenance of clients Database and Account opening for Legal, Non-Legal, corporate, bonds, and financial







data. Collaborate with the Due-diligence team for the details regarding the Ultimate Beneficiary Owners and perform the vigilance checks and upload the same in the system.

3

Key Highlights: Appreciation mails from the counterparts for completing various projects with an accuracy and timely manner also received a COSMOS award for the quarter.

Nomura Services India Pvt. Ltd. Sep 2007 - Aug 2010



•

Analyst: Reconciliation performed as per firms standards. Reconciliation was done with the Finance side positionvstheRisksidepositions. (Break Investigation & Resolution) Performed root cause analysis (RCA) on reconciliation breaks. Product Control, IT Team and Risk Managers- Identify IT related issues and escalated to Risk Control and Business Analyst for prioritization and resolution Provide daily weekly cadence of all the position and accounts breaks with a market value greater than the provided threshold.

Managed cross-functional initiatives supporting daily risk reporting for various products. •

Analysed complex reconciliation workflows across various products, identifying inefficiencies that reduced manual processing by 30%. Collaborated with Technology to automate exception reporting dashboards using Power BI to get rid of oversight errors. Also assisted in automation initiatives that reduced manual reconciliation tasks by 30%. Achievements: Successfully migrated Asia Market Risk Reconciliation process and conducted training sessions for the same.





JPMorgan Services India Pvt. Ltd Feb 2005 - Aug 2007

Process LIVE market trades which were received via Swift, Indian Markets, US and others.
